summary: No material bug or false camera-clearance, native-UV, or current-mesh completeness claim found. No rebuilds, rerenders, source edits, or publication performed.

scope.method: Decoded GLB POSITION/TEXCOORD_0/index buffers, unioned actual cover triangles, transformed actual camera rim/cover/flash vertices through node hierarchies into screen space, checked projected hull clearance and normal separation. Independently compared triangle union to profile polygon minus apertures; inspected SVG XML and existing images.

pass.evidence: All 14 Flip exports have zero projected cover-screen overlap with camera rims, optical covers, and flash. Minimum gaps: Flip3 6.302791 mm; Flip4 6.216291 mm; Flip5 1.245025 mm; Flip6/7 FE 0.555323 mm; Flip7/8 camera rims 0.349893 mm and flash 0.249923 mm. Fold/TriFold hardware belongs to other leaves: unfolded projections are separate; folded projections overlap only across chassis depth, with at least 9.114999 mm normal separation.

All six folder exports contain 398 screen triangles and no holes; all four full-screen Flip7/8 exports contain 520 triangles and three hardware holes. Independent surface-minus-triangle-union comparison of the helper has at most 1.86e-14 mm2 missing area for these inputs. Actual changed GLB meshes differ from expected polygons by less than 0.000222 mm2 symmetric area, consistent with float32 precision.
All 30 GLB cover meshes match the full fit_box_mm UV rectangle, accounting for glTF V inversion. Maximum absolute UV error below 5.3e-8; no remapping to the folder's inset edge or camera holes.
All ten changed SVGs match their declared opening dimensions and profile cutout centers/radii. Folder SVG polygons exactly represent outline_mm; mesh resampling difference is recorded below.

Profile scan found mesh_cutouts enabled only for the ten intended Flip5/6/7 FE/7/8 cover screens. None uses edge_curve_mm or split object_parts; the false branch bypasses the helper. Existing Flip3/4, Fold and TriFold GLBs retain complete original cover surfaces within float32 precision.

pass.check: Existing visual evidence and official sources
pass.evidence: Inspected Flip5-folded and Flip7-folded cover-front.png plus cover-check-closed.png. Samsung Flip5 Main1.gif frame 20 visibly supports a shallow S recess; Samsung Flip7 press images support a full cover surrounding two cameras and flash. Existing sample evidence shows unobstructed hardware.

The reported 398/520 triangle counts, hardware-hole counts, clearances and native UV claims were independently confirmed for the relevant exports. Current results support safety of all 15 Samsung model cover layouts; historical performance of the worker's claimed checks is not independently provable.

limitations.detail: Folder mesh uses a 400-point resampling, while build.py:725 emits the original outline into SVG. Measured maximum boundary separation is 0.0481521 mm (about 0.58 native pixel). Correspondence is approximate, not bit-for-bit; no material visual defect found.

The helper uses unconstrained Delaunay triangulation filtered by polygon coverage. Completeness was verified for every currently enabled input, not established for arbitrary future concave shapes. Flat circular-aperture use only was reviewed; combinations with curved/split screens or noncircular cutouts were not exercised.

Samsung photos support topology and general appearance, not CAD-accurate contour, bezel, camera positions or corner radii. Flip6/7 FE reuse of the Flip5 envelope and Flip8 visual accuracy were not independently traced against separate official imagery.

No rebuilds, rerenders, runtime/gallery checks, material/finish validation, or full articulation sweep. Existing screenshots were inspected as supplied; actual exported GLB geometry was independently inspected. No prior baseline snapshots were available to prove byte-for-byte absence of unrelated changes.

sources.visual: Downloaded original GIF into memory and inspected frame 20 via temporary PNG.
Inspected official hero and multi-device FlexWindow photographs.
